title: Application of Boston Gas Company for approval by the Department of Telecommunications and Energy for a waiver from the requirements in 49 C.F.R. Part 192, for undergound installation of plastic pipe for a bridge crossing to be located in Dudley/Webster, Massachusetts.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: A letter from Richard B. Felder. To Mr. Smallcomb stating that the DTE has granted the Boston Gas Company a Waiver from Compliance with 49 CFR 192.321 (a) for plastic pipe across the French River Bridge on Oxford Avenue at the Dudley/Webster Town Line. By Richard B. Felder. DTE 99-22-C
Order Issued. Commissioners Participated Besser, Connelly, Keating, Vasington, Sullivan. DTE 99-22-C
